part: W4 Living Room 3 (separate file so that the fixture protocol bytes stay frozen while its chain runs)
frozen_before: LR3 comparative results (added and committed before any LR3 run; the fixture chain was already running, no LR3 output existed).
ref_note: Ref-65 / Ref-7 copied from Main's own copy of the TransGI data (identical sha256 to LabServer69's WL102 re-render). The isolated scene copy differs from LabServer69's scene_transgi.xml only in CRLF line endings; Session regenerates it and its modified_sha256 must equal the reference manifest.
primary: GI LDR RMSE against Ref-65 (WL102 / TransGI convention clip(x,0,1)^(1/2.2)), and GI relative debiased HDR RMSE (WL111 primary form) - both reported; the LDR RMSE is primary for LR3 because every historical LR3 number (paper Table I, WL102, TransGI reproduction) uses it.

eval_L40_adopted.role: TransGI best quality: adopted B24 L40 checkpoint (b23_lz_i4_seed0, sha256 1b32a633...) with the adopted evaluation options, at the WL102 resolution

eval_L40_fastmatched.role: Quality at the settings the timed fast frame uses (1-spp G-buffer, no albedo prefilter, 1-spp specular DI)

eval_wl102_repro.role: Host reproduction check of the WL102 TransGI result (historical GI LDR RMSE 0.0775 on LabServer69)

bench_L40_640.role: TransGI fast-frame timing on Main (reproduction's own benchmark, median of 200 warm frames)

bench_L40_1080.role: Same at 1920 x 1080 (paper Table I resolution)

transgi_exclusivity: TransGI runs only after the fixture chain has finished (sequential GPU use); its own benchmark script synchronises per frame.
ecro_lr3: Historical (WL102, LabServer69 RTX 3090): GI LDR RMSE vs Ref-65 0.170 at 4 spp, 0.102 converged; truncation-only 0.096; frame 27.3 / 27.7 ms (unoptimised path). Not re-run on Main: it needs the 11 GB WL102 dataset for its generator state and an unoptimised frame path; its LR3 gate status is decided by quality (its truncation floor alone exceeds TransGI's error), which a new timing cannot change. Recorded QUALIFIED_WITH_LIMITATIONS (quality) / cross-hardware (time).
scene_check_amendment: Pre-run correction (code-path smoke, before any LR3 result): on Windows the Session writes scene_transgi.xml with CRLF line endings, so its raw sha256 (bd062579...) differs from LabServer69's (62583fb9...) although the content is identical. The check is on the LF-normalised sha256 of the written XML.
